$comment: English texts of data/quests.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the narrator's daily, weekly and monthly quests. A kind's {noun} is its `counted` form after {count} (src/engine/quests.js, questText): English has [one, other, other] for the Polish [one, few, many]. In kill the noun comes from monsters.json, in brew from professions.json, and gather's {herb} is the herb's `genitive` there.

daily.name: Daily

chest.text: The daily quest chest gives +30 Time Points and +5 System Points.

daily.rerolled: Today's quests have already been rerolled.

weekly.name: Weekly

chest.text: The weekly quest chest gives a random item, +120 Time Points and +20 System Points.

weekly.late: This week began later for you, so the quests are for {days} of its 7 days.
weekly.rerolled: This week's quests have already been rerolled.

monthly.name: Monthly

chest.text: The monthly quest chest gives gold based on your level, +240 Time Points and +50 System Points.

monthly.late: The quests are for {days} of this month's {total} days.
monthly.rerolled: This month's quests have already been rerolled.
